parity_initialization: Same parameter seed and architecture; constant one-hot versus zeros can change initial Q values and finite-budget optimization.
llm_prompt: Choose a desired outcome for a low-level FPS policy. Hit the visible Doom target with few decisions. HIT_TARGET permits movement and shooting to kill the native target. Goals persist until achieved or the episode ends. Return only JSON with exactly one key: {"goal":"ALIGN_WITHOUT_FIRE"} or {"goal":"HIT_TARGET"}.
